title: CNC — tool life (alert source)
description: One panel per line with the machine hard-coded, so each panel can be turned into an alert rule. Alert rules cannot expand dashboard variables, which is why there is no machine picker here.

panels.title: line 01 · hermle_c400 — tool life
panels.description:
Remaining tool life on the line 01 milling centre. 100% is a fresh tool; it steps back to 100% at every tool change, so an alert on this fires once per tool rather than continuously.

To build the alert from this panel: New alert rule -> the query below is A -> add Reduce(Last, A) as B -> add Threshold(B is below 10) as C. Set the rule's evaluation window to something short (now-15m to now) and give it a pending period of a minute or two so a single missed sample cannot fire it. Decide the No data case deliberately: an idle or disconnected machine returns no rows, and 'No data = Alerting' would then page for a machine nobody is using.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT v.ts AS "time", v.value_num AS "tool life"
FROM umh.value_cnc v
  JOIN umh.topic t ON t.topic_id = v.topic_id
  JOIN umh.tag g ON g.tag_id = t.tag_id
  JOIN umh.location l ON l.location_id = t.location_id
WHERE l.path = 'umh-factory.cologne.milling_center.line_01.hermle_c400'::ltree
  AND g.data_contract_name = '_cnc'
  AND g.virtual_path = 'tool'
  AND g.name = 'life_pct'
  AND $__timeFilter(v.ts)
ORDER BY 1
